name: Green ribbon

magic.curse: Anyone within 60 feet who is dying finds the dark pulling harder: they take a -1 penalty on death saves, and a worse one each time the ribbon is used. (Reference only; the penalty is not applied by the game yet.)

summary: Worn at the neck, it adds 5 to your death saving throws. It is cursed.
text: A faded green ribbon, soft with age and still faintly warm. Attuned to it, you add 5 to your Death Saving Throws. Reference-only, not run by the game: tied round the neck of a dead non-undead creature within 10 days, it raises them (they die again if it is taken off); when you drop to 0 Hit Points, you may use your Reaction to regain Hit Points equal to half your level, once per dusk, or at once if you roll a natural 20 on a Death Saving Throw. Curse: other creatures within 60 feet of you take -1 on death saves, and worse each time you use the ribbon's healing.
